title: He Was Trapped Under a Boulder and Made an Unthinkable Decision
sources: Aron Ralston, 'Between a Rock and a Hard Place' (2004)
The Guardian, 'The man who cut off his own arm to save his life'

lines.text: In April 2003, a twenty-seven-year-old climber named Mr. Aron Ralston set out for a solo adventure in Utah's canyon country.
lines.caps: In April 2003, | a 27-year-old climber | Mr. Aron Ralston | set out for | a solo adventure.

lines.text: He didn't tell a single person where he was going.
lines.caps: He didn't tell | a single person | where he was going.

lines.text: Deep inside Blue John Canyon, he was squeezing through a narrow slot...
lines.caps: Deep inside | Blue John Canyon, | he was squeezing | through a narrow slot...

lines.text: when an eight-hundred-pound boulder suddenly shifted and crushed his right hand against the canyon wall.
lines.caps: when an 800-pound boulder | suddenly shifted | and crushed | his right hand | against the wall.

lines.text: He was completely alone. No phone signal. No one knew he was there.
lines.caps: He was alone. | No phone signal. | No one knew | he was there.

lines.text: He pushed. He pulled. He chipped at the rock with a cheap pocket knife.
lines.caps: He pushed. | He pulled. | He chipped | at the rock | with a pocket knife.

lines.text: Nothing worked.
lines.caps: Nothing worked.

lines.text: By the second day, his water ran out.
lines.caps: By the second day, | his water | ran out.

lines.text: By the third day, he was drinking his own urine to stay alive.
lines.caps: By the third day, | he was drinking | his own urine | to stay alive.

lines.text: He carved his own name and the date he expected to die into the canyon wall.
lines.caps: He carved his name | and the date | he expected to die | into the canyon wall.

lines.text: But on the fifth morning, something changed.
lines.caps: But on the fifth morning, | something changed.

lines.text: He saw a vision of a little boy... his future son, running toward him.
lines.caps: He saw a vision | of a little boy... | his future son, | running toward him.

lines.text: And in that moment, Mr. Ralston decided: he was NOT going to die in this canyon.
lines.caps: And in that moment, | Mr. Ralston decided: | he was NOT | going to die | in this canyon.

lines.text: What he did next is almost impossible to believe.
lines.caps: What he did next | is almost impossible | to believe.

lines.text: He snapped his own forearm bones by leveraging them against the boulder.
lines.caps: He snapped | his own forearm bones | by leveraging them | against the boulder.

lines.text: Then, with a dull pocket knife, he cut through his own arm to set himself free.
lines.caps: Then, with a dull knife, | he cut through | his own arm | to set himself free.

lines.text: It took over an hour.
lines.caps: It took | over an hour.

lines.text: Bleeding and barely conscious, Mr. Ralston rappelled down a sixty-five-foot cliff.
lines.caps: Bleeding and barely conscious, | Mr. Ralston | rappelled down | a 65-foot cliff.

lines.text: Then he walked eight miles through the blazing desert sun.
lines.caps: Then he walked | eight miles | through the blazing | desert sun.

lines.text: A rescue helicopter finally spotted him and rushed him to the hospital.
lines.caps: A rescue helicopter | finally spotted him | and rushed him | to the hospital.

lines.text: Against every odd, Mr. Aron Ralston survived.
lines.caps: Against every odd, | Mr. Aron Ralston | survived.

lines.text: He didn't just survive. He went back to climbing mountains.
lines.caps: He didn't just survive. | He went back | to climbing mountains.

lines.text: He even climbed all of Colorado's fifty-nine tallest peaks... with one arm.
lines.caps: He even climbed | all of Colorado's | 59 tallest peaks... | with one arm.

lines.text: Some rocks are meant to stop you. Others are meant to show you what you're made of.
lines.caps: Some rocks | are meant to stop you. | Others are meant | to show you | what you're made of.
